summary: W.P. III, 51, of Arvada became separated from his family near the Sandbeach Lake campground in the Wild Basin region and was reported missing around 3:30 p.m. Thursday; rangers found him about 5 p.m. Friday after hearing him blow a rescue whistle, dried and warmed him on scene, and he walked roughly four-and-a-half miles out with rangers to the trailhead, then was transported to Estes Park Medical Center for non-emergency care.
location: Sandbeach Lake campground, Wild Basin, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers
notes: NPS morning-report compendium entry dated 2012-07-10; date = day reported missing (found Friday 2012-07-06).
